import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    two=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2][0]
    one=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==1][0]
    dr,dc=one[0]-two[0],one[1]-two[1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    sr,sc=(1 if dr>0 else -1),(1 if dc>0 else -1)
    # one diagonal step, then straight along dominant axis, then diagonal toward 1
    cur=(two[0]+sr,two[1]+sc)
    out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    if abs(dr)>=abs(dc):
        n=abs(dr)-abs(dc)+1
        for _ in range(n): cur=(cur[0]+sr,cur[1]); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    else:
        n=abs(dc)-abs(dr)+1
        for _ in range(n): cur=(cur[0],cur[1]+sc); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    for _ in range(abs(dr)+abs(dc)-max(abs(dr),abs(dc))-1):
        cur=(cur[0]+sr,cur[1]+sc)
        out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
t=f(G['Test input'])
for r,row in enumerate(t): print(f'{r:2d}',''.join(str(x) if x else '.' for x in row))
print(json.dumps(t))

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def gen(inp, mode):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    two=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2][0]
    one=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==1][0]
    dr,dc=one[0]-two[0],one[1]-two[1]
    sr,sc=(1 if dr>0 else -1),(1 if dc>0 else -1)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    k=min(abs(dr),abs(dc))-2  # diagonal-first length
    # D segment
    cur=(two[0]+sr,two[1]+sc); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    for _ in range(k-1):
        cur=(cur[0]+sr,cur[1]+sc); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    # dominant-axis straight for L = max-1-k
    if abs(dr)>=abs(dc):
        L=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))-1-k
        sign=sr
        for _ in range(L):
            cur=(cur[0]+sign,cur[1]); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    else:
        L=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))-1-k
        sign=sc
        for _ in range(L):
            cur=(cur[0],cur[1]+sign); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
    # final diagonal until adjacent to target
    while True:
        nr,nc=cur[0]+sr,cur[1]+sc
        if (nr,nc)==one or (abs(nr-one[0])+abs(nc-one[1])==1 and abs(nr-one[0])==abs(nc-one[1])): break
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        out[nr][nc]=3; cur=(nr,nc)
    return out
ok=True
for k in range(1,5):
    r=gen(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'],0)
    print(k, r==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
# test
i=G['Test input']
t=gen(i,0)
for r,row in enumerate(t): print(f'{r:2d}',''.join(str(x) if x else '.' for x in row))
print(json.dumps(t))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    two=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2][0]
    one=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==1][0]
    dr,dc=one[0]-two[0],one[1]-two[1]
    sr,sc=(1 if dr>0 else -1),(1 if dc>0 else -1)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cur=(two[0]+sr,two[1]+sc); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3   # 1 diagonal step away
    if abs(dr)>=abs(dc):                      # dominant = row axis -> straight along rows
        # perp coord (col) must stay = two col + sc ; find t so row becomes one_row - t*sr
        t=(one[0]-two[0]-sr)/sr
        Q=(one[0]-t*sr, two[1]+sc)
        L=abs(t)-1                                 # straight length before final diag
        for _ in range(L):
            cur=(cur[0]+sr,cur[1]); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
        while True:
            nr,nc=cur[0]+sr,cur[1]+sc
            if (nr,nc)==one: break                # allowed to overlap target
            out[nr][nc]=3; cur=(nr,nc)
    else:                                      # dominant = col axis
        t=(one[1]-two[1]-sc)/sc
        Q=(two[0]+sr, one[1]-t*sc)
        L=abs(t)-1
        for _ in range(L):
            cur=(cur[0],cur[1]+sc); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
        while True:
            nr,nc=cur[0]+sr,cur[1]+sc
            if (nr,nc)==one: break
            out[nr][nc]=3; cur=(nr,nc)
    return out

def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    two=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2][0]

    tr,tc=two; orow,ocol=one
    dr,dz=orow-tr,ocol-tc
    sr,sc=(1 if dr>0 else -1),(1 if dz>0 else -1)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # orientation: straight along axis of smaller |diff|
    if abs(dr)<abs(dz): orient='h'   # straight is horizontal (constant row)

        r0=tr+(1 if dr>0 else -1)
        # diagonal runs on slope; walk from one-adjacent cell toward two until hitting row r0
        cur=(orow-sr,ocol-sc)
        diag=[]
        while cur[0]!=r0:
            diag.append(cur); cur=(cur[0]+sr,cur[1]+sc)
        corner=cur
        # straight along row r0 toward two's column
        step=(1 if tc>ocol else -1)
        e=(r0, tc+step)  # diag-adjacent to two on this row
        straight=[(r0,c) for c in range(e[1],corner[1]-step+1,step)]
    else:
        c0=tc+(1 if dz>0 else -1)
        cur=(orow-sr,ocol-sc)
        diag=[]

        e=(tr+step, c0)
        straight=[(r,c0) for r in range(e[0],corner[0]-step+1,step)]
    for c in diag+straight: out[c[0]][c[1]]=3
    return out

 but my replace turned it into real newline — but then split('
